_comment: Canonical STATIC facts = the single source of truth the L13 consistency linter (check_consistency.py) enforces across every LIVE file. Dynamic weekly values (chamber counts) live on the Sheet, not here. When a static fact genuinely changes (a member switches caucus, reapportionment), change it HERE and let L13 flag every file that still disagrees. This file and check_consistency.py are excluded from the scan (they define the patterns, so they would self-match).

notes.murkowski: Murkowski-AK is a Republican counted in SENATE_R, NOT an independent (corrected 2026-08-03, senate.gov).
notes.kiley: Kiley (CA-03) is Independent but caucuses R; counted as I in HOUSE_I.
notes.senate_overlap: The two independents caucus D and are counted INSIDE SENATE_D. SENATE_R + SENATE_D == 100; the overlap sum SENATE_R + SENATE_D + SENATE_I == 102 is correct.

drift_patterns.name: three-independents
drift_patterns.why: There are two Senate independents (Sanders, King); Murkowski is R.

drift_patterns.name: murkowski-independent
drift_patterns.why: Murkowski is a registered Republican, not an independent.

drift_patterns.name: senate-i-3-prose
drift_patterns.why: SENATE_I must be 2 (Murkowski is R); corrected 2026-08-03.

drift_patterns.name: senate-sum-103
drift_patterns.why: With SENATE_I=2 the overlap sum is 102, not 103.
